apariciones.subtitulo: Conclusion first, story second

mision.consigna: Summarise a news story you followed this week for a friend who missed it — no real names needed.
requisitos: the main point in your first sentence
no more than three supporting points

microtareas.texto: Summarise a news article in exactly 50 words. Start with the conclusion.
Same article, 15 words. What did you have to drop?
Record 90 seconds: what's the difference between *fake news* and a mistake? Start with *In short,*.

apariciones.subtitulo: What would have happened if you'd checked first

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a purchase that went wrong and what would have been different if you'd done one thing earlier.
requisitos: one with *could have* or *might have* in the result

microtareas.texto: Write three *If I had…, I wouldn't have…* sentences about shopping.
Rewrite one of them starting with *Had I…*.
Record 90 seconds: a *bargain* that wasn't. Use two third conditionals.

apariciones.subtitulo: Make, take, have — the right verb with the noun

mision.consigna: Write an email to your manager asking to join a training course next month.
requisitos: six verb+noun collocations from the reference box
no *do a decision* or *make a risk* type errors

microtareas.texto: List ten nouns from your work and write the verb each one takes.
Three sentences with *make an effort*, *take a risk*, *have a chance* about your *career path*.
Record 90 seconds on *lifelong learning*. Count your collocations afterwards.

apariciones.subtitulo: Softening a food opinion so it doesn't offend

mision.consigna: Give honest feedback on a dish a friend cooked for you that you didn't really like.
requisitos: one *It might just be my taste*

microtareas.texto: Write three blunt opinions about food, then soften each one.
Change *That's wrong* to five softer versions.
Record 90 seconds on a dish you don't like, softened throughout.

apariciones.subtitulo: What your manager said, reported accurately

mision.consigna: Report a conversation with a manager about a promotion — to a colleague who wasn't there.
requisitos: four reported statements with the tense moved back

microtareas.texto: Write five things your manager said last week in reported speech. Check tense, pronouns, time words.
Report three questions from a *job interview*.
Record 90 seconds: what did someone tell you when they decided *to quit*?

apariciones.subtitulo: If you were in charge of the office

mision.consigna: Describe how you would change one public office or service if you were in charge of it.
requisitos: one question with *What would you do if…?*
use *to fill in a form*, *deadline* and *to be in charge of*

microtareas.texto: Five sentences: *If I were in charge of…, I would…*.
Three pieces of advice with *If I were you* for someone applying for a *certificate*.
Record 90 seconds: what would you change about *customer service* in your country?

apariciones.subtitulo: Negotiating your way into a new culture

mision.consigna: Persuade a new flatmate from another country to try one local custom they find strange.
requisitos: one small first step you propose
use *local custom*, *to settle in* and *culture shock*

microtareas.texto: Write what your flatmate might object to and one reason it helps them.
Three offers that make the first step small.
Record 90 seconds persuading someone with *wanderlust* to stay one more year.

apariciones.subtitulo: Regrets about free time

mision.consigna: Write about a hobby you gave up and what you'd do differently.
requisitos: use *to take up a hobby*, *club* and *leisure activity*

microtareas.texto: Write three *I wish I'd…* sentences about a *club* you left.
Turn one into *If I'd…, I would have…*.
Record 90 seconds: what *should* you *have* done to *relax* more last year?

apariciones.subtitulo: Same news, two registers

mision.consigna: Tell a friend and your IT department about the same data problem with a work app.
requisitos: one informal message with contractions and phrasal verbs

microtareas.texto: Write *Can't make it — sorry!* in formal register.
Rewrite a short formal email you received as a text to a friend.
Record 90 seconds explaining *artificial intelligence* to a friend, then 30 seconds formally.

apariciones.subtitulo: Suggestions for a housing problem

mision.consigna: You and a friend are both looking for a flat. Suggest how you could look together.

microtareas.texto: Three suggestions for *house hunting* with *How about…?*
Reply to each with an alternative.
Record 90 seconds: what could people do who are *priced out*?

apariciones.subtitulo: Keeping going when the word won't come

mision.consigna: Explain to someone what you do to stay fit, without stopping when you lose a word.
requisitos: two fillers that keep your turn (*Hold on, let me think*)
one self-correction (*Let me say that again*)
one question handing over the turn
use *to stay fit*, *to reduce stress* and *wellbeing*

microtareas.texto: Write three phrases you'll use when you forget a word.
Talk about your *diet* for one minute without stopping. When you stall, use a phrase.
Record 90 seconds on *wellbeing*. End with *What do you think?*

apariciones.subtitulo: Prepositions that come with the verb

mision.consigna: Write a short text about how you decide what to do with your savings.
requisitos: six prepositional verbs from the reference box
two with *-ing* after the preposition (*insist on doing*)
one question ending in a preposition
use *savings account*, *savings buffer* and *to get into debt*

microtareas.texto: Ten verbs with their preposition about money.
Three sentences with *depend on* and *rely on* about your *retirement fund*.
Record 90 seconds: what does a good budget *depend on*?

apariciones.subtitulo: One better word instead of very

mision.consigna: Write a short post about something your town does for the climate.
requisitos: four clearer alternatives from the reference box or your own
one sentence you rewrote twice to find the right word

microtareas.texto: Circle every *very* and *good* in something you wrote this week. Replace them.
Five sentences about *greenhouse gases* without *a lot*.
Record 90 seconds on *climate change*. Replay and count *very*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Phrasal verbs for relationships

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a friendship or relationship: how it started, the hard moments and where it is now.
requisitos: six phrasal verbs from the reference box
no formal one-word alternative where a phrasal verb fits

microtareas.texto: Five formal verbs about relationships, then the phrasal verb for each.
Three sentences with *put up with* and *get used to*.
Record 90 seconds about someone who *got engaged*. Four phrasal verbs.

apariciones.subtitulo: Shorter sentences in a news report

mision.consigna: Write a short news report about a false story that spread online.
requisitos: one sentence where you keep *who* or *which* because it's needed

microtareas.texto: Write five sentences with *which was* or *who is*, then cut them.
Three sentences about a *headline* with a participle.
Record 90 seconds: why does *fake news* spread?

apariciones.subtitulo: What had already happened when you found out

mision.consigna: Tell the story of an online order that went wrong.
requisitos: use *delivery*, *a refund* and *to complain about something*

microtareas.texto: Five pairs of past events: which happened first? Write them with the past perfect.
Three sentences with *It wasn't until … that…* about *online shopping*.
Record 90 seconds: a *bargain* that turned out badly.

apariciones.subtitulo: Finished time or still now

mision.consigna: Write about how a relationship in your life has changed over the years.
requisitos: four past simple sentences with a finished time

microtareas.texto: Five things you've done this year and five things you did last year.
Three *Have you ever…?* questions about family.
Record 90 seconds: how long have you known your closest friend?

apariciones.subtitulo: Feedback on a health plan

mision.consigna: A friend asks what you think of their new fitness plan. Give them feedback.
requisitos: describe what happened, not what kind of person they are
one thing that works and one to change
one *Next time, it might be worth…*

microtareas.texto: Write two feedback sentences: one about the person, one about the plan. Keep the second.
Rewrite *You're too lazy* as feedback about behaviour.
Record 90 seconds giving feedback on someone's *wellbeing* routine.

apariciones.subtitulo: Agreeing and disagreeing about tourism

mision.consigna: Someone says mass tourism is always bad. Respond in a group discussion.
requisitos: no direct attack on the person

microtareas.texto: Three statements about tourism: agree with one, disagree with two.
Change *That's wrong* into three polite versions.
Record 90 seconds disagreeing with: *Tourists should always adapt completely.*

apariciones.subtitulo: Comparing two ways to spend free time

mision.consigna: Compare joining a club with doing a hobby alone.
requisitos: one *whereas* and one *on the other hand*

microtareas.texto: List three things in common and three differences.
Write two sentences with *whereas*.
Record 90 seconds: *volunteering* or a paid hobby? Compare, then choose.

apariciones.subtitulo: An opinion on exams with a reason

mision.consigna: Give your opinion: should adults have to take exams in continuing education?

microtareas.texto: Your opinion in one sentence. Underneath, two reasons.
Ask someone *What do you think about…?* and note their answer.
Record 90 seconds: how do you *keep up to date* in your job?

apariciones.subtitulo: Softer claims at work

mision.consigna: Write a short report on why staff are leaving a team, without claiming more than you know.

microtareas.texto: Three blunt sentences about your *manager*. Hedge them.
Rewrite two active sentences as passives.
Record 90 seconds on *staff turnover*, careful with every claim.

apariciones.subtitulo: The story of a flat search

mision.consigna: Tell the story of how you found (or didn't find) a place to live.
requisitos: clear order: *first, then, after that, in the end*

microtareas.texto: Put your story in five bullet points.
Three sentences with *had already… before…*.
Record 90 seconds of the whole story. Check your tenses.

apariciones.subtitulo: Advice for dealing with an office

mision.consigna: A friend has to deal with a government office for the first time. Give them advice.
requisitos: three pieces of advice with different forms
one reason for each piece of advice
use *official errand*, *customer service* and *to be in charge of*

microtareas.texto: Five tips about *filling in a form*.
Rewrite three *You must* sentences as advice.
Record 90 seconds of advice for someone *appealing a decision*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Summarising a recipe discussion

mision.consigna: Summarise a cooking video or recipe article for someone with a food intolerance.
requisitos: the main point first, a different opening from last time

microtareas.texto: Summarise a recipe in 40 words.
What would you leave out for someone who can't *season* with salt?
Record 90 seconds: *The main thing is…* about eating *seasonal* food.

apariciones.subtitulo: Softening claims about technology

mision.consigna: A colleague asks if the team should let AI write reports. Answer carefully.
requisitos: four softening devices, different from last time
use *artificial intelligence*, *automation* and *to train a model*

microtareas.texto: Three strong claims about *algorithms*. Soften each.
Rewrite one that you softened too much.
Record 90 seconds on *screen time*, softened but clear.

apariciones.subtitulo: Negotiating on the climate at home

mision.consigna: Persuade your family to change one habit to cut your carbon footprint.
requisitos: one *I can't do that, but I could…*

microtareas.texto: Write what each person wants and one thing you could offer.
Three offers with *If you could…*.
Record 90 seconds persuading someone about *greenhouse gases*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Commas that change the meaning

mision.consigna: Describe the people and places involved in managing your money.
requisitos: three defining and three non-defining relative clauses
correct commas in all of them

microtareas.texto: Five sentences about your bank. Which clauses need commas?
One sentence with and without commas. What changes?
Record 90 seconds: someone *who* helped you with money.

apariciones.subtitulo: Must have, might have, can't have at the office

mision.consigna: Your application at an office has disappeared. Work out what must have happened.

microtareas.texto: Five guesses about why there's a *delay*.
Rewrite them from most to least certain.
Record 90 seconds: what *must have* happened to your file?

apariciones.subtitulo: Holding the conversation about hobbies

mision.consigna: Talk with a friend about starting a new sport, keeping the conversation going even when you lose a word.
requisitos: two ways to join the conversation, different from last time
one question that asks for their view
use *to take up a hobby*, *club* and *pastime*

microtareas.texto: Write three ways to add something when others are talking.
Talk for one minute about your *spare time* without stopping.
Record 90 seconds on *volunteering*. Hand over at the end.

apariciones.subtitulo: What will we be eating in ten years?

mision.consigna: Predict how people's diets will change in your country in the next ten years.
requisitos: use *food waste*, *food intolerance* and *to cut down on something*

microtareas.texto: Three predictions about *food waste*, from sure to unsure.
Write *There's a good chance that…* about eating *seasonal* food.
Record 90 seconds: will people *cut down on* meat?

apariciones.subtitulo: Regrets about moving abroad

mision.consigna: Someone you met abroad is still annoyed about a misunderstanding between you. Write them a message looking back on it.
requisitos: one *I wish I'd…*, one *It's a shame that…*
one modal perfect and one third conditional
a different situation from the last time you wrote about regret
use *a misunderstanding*, *to fit in* and *a sense of belonging*

microtareas.texto: Three *I wish I'd…* sentences about living abroad.
One third conditional about *culture shock*.
Record 90 seconds: a *stereotype* you believed and shouldn't have.

apariciones.subtitulo: Stopped doing or stopped to do

mision.consigna: Write about how you recovered from an illness or injury.
requisitos: four verbs followed by a gerund
use *recovery*, *to take it easy* and *side effect*

microtareas.texto: Ten verbs: gerund or infinitive? Write one sentence each.
Two sentences with *stop -ing* and *stop to* about your *recovery*.
Record 90 seconds: what do you *enjoy doing* when you're ill?

apariciones.subtitulo: Suggestions for using technology at home

mision.consigna: Suggest to your family how to manage screen time and software updates.
requisitos: three suggestions with different forms from last time

microtareas.texto: Three suggestions about *screen time*.
Reply to one suggestion with an alternative.
Record 90 seconds: how could we use *artificial intelligence* at home?

apariciones.subtitulo: I wish we recycled more

mision.consigna: Write about what you'd like to change in your own environmental habits.
requisitos: three *I wish* with the past simple (about now)

microtareas.texto: Five *I wish* sentences about now, not the past.
Two *It's time we…* sentences about *recycling*.
Record 90 seconds: *If only* everyone used *renewable energy*…

apariciones.subtitulo: Idioms people actually say about learning

mision.consigna: Tell the story of getting a foreign qualification recognised or retraining.
requisitos: three idioms from the reference box, one per paragraph
one *to cut a long story short*

microtareas.texto: Pick three idioms and write when you'd use them.
Write about *retraining* with *as a last resort*.
Record 90 seconds on a *final exam*. One idiom.

apariciones.subtitulo: Linking ideas about family

mision.consigna: Write about a family relationship that became distant and what happened.
requisitos: six discourse markers from the reference box
use *to grow apart*, *to forgive* and *shared values*

microtareas.texto: Write five sentences without markers. Then connect them.
Three sentences with *On top of that* and *Given that*.
Record 90 seconds on being *disappointed* by someone. Use four markers.

apariciones.subtitulo: A complaint at work that asks for something

mision.consigna: Write to your manager about your workload.
requisitos: what happened, what it caused, what you want
one *I'd appreciate it if you could…*
one *I'd like this sorted out by…*
use *workload*, *work-life balance* and *to work from home*

microtareas.texto: Write the problem in three sentences.
Write three polite requests.
Record 90 seconds making the complaint to your *manager*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Always, never, really — in the right place

mision.consigna: Describe your news habits for a survey on how people follow the news.
requisitos: six frequency adverbs in the right place
two with *be* and two with auxiliaries
one adverb at the end of the sentence
use *headline*, *to form an opinion* and *freedom of the press*

microtareas.texto: Five sentences about the news with *always*, *usually*, *never*.
Check: before the main verb, after *be*?
Record 90 seconds: how do you *fact-check* a *headline*?

apariciones.subtitulo: Feedback on someone's new flat

mision.consigna: You helped a friend move into a housing cooperative. A month later, they ask you what the co-op could do better for new residents. Tell them.
requisitos: behaviour and effect, not the person
one positive and one thing to change, different phrasing from last time
use *to move house*, *utility bills* and *good transport links*

microtareas.texto: Two feedback sentences on a *housing cooperative* flat.
Rewrite *Your flat is ugly* as useful feedback.
Record 90 seconds giving feedback on a friend's move.

apariciones.subtitulo: Who did it doesn't matter — the passive

mision.consigna: Write a short report about how a clothing company changed after criticism of its working conditions.
requisitos: five passive sentences in different tenses
one active sentence where the actor matters

microtareas.texto: Five active sentences about *online shopping*, then passive.
Three sentences with *has been* and *can be*.
Record 90 seconds: what *has been done* about *fast fashion*?

apariciones.subtitulo: Predictions about banking

mision.consigna: Your bank has announced changes to its accounts. Explain to a friend how you think this will affect ordinary customers.
requisitos: four predictions, different forms from last time

microtareas.texto: Three predictions about *bank transfers*.
Say why you're sure or unsure about each.
Record 90 seconds: will *fees* go up?

apariciones.subtitulo: Disagreeing about club rules

mision.consigna: Your club wants to raise its membership fee. Discuss it at a meeting.
requisitos: two agreements and two disagreements, different formulas from last time
one *I see it a bit differently*
use *club rules*, *leisure activity* and *to let off steam*

microtareas.texto: Three statements about *club rules*: agree or disagree politely.
Write one *Yes, but…* and one *I agree with you on that*.
Record 90 seconds disagreeing about *volunteering* in clubs.

apariciones.subtitulo: Comparing life with and without technology

mision.consigna: Compare how your parents' generation and yours deal with technology.
requisitos: use *digital divide*, *to keep up with technology* and *to replace jobs*

microtareas.texto: Three similarities and three differences.
Two sentences with *whereas* about *screen time*.
Record 90 seconds: will *artificial intelligence* *replace jobs*?

apariciones.subtitulo: An opinion on buying less

mision.consigna: Give your opinion: should we repair things rather than replace them?
requisitos: a clear opinion with two reasons
use *to repair rather than replace*, *fast fashion* and *brand loyalty*

microtareas.texto: Your opinion in one sentence, two reasons underneath.
An example of *renting instead of buying*.
Record 90 seconds on *working conditions* and shopping.

apariciones.subtitulo: Careful claims about learning online

mision.consigna: Write a short report on whether online courses work as well as classroom ones.
requisitos: two hedges, different ones from last time
use *to stay motivated*, *advanced training* and *common thread*

microtareas.texto: Three claims about online courses. Hedge them.
Two passives about *advanced training*.
Record 90 seconds: how do you *stay on top of things*?

apariciones.subtitulo: A story about getting moving again

mision.consigna: Tell the story of a time you went from a sedentary routine to a more active one.
requisitos: clear order with different time words from last time

microtareas.texto: Your story in five points.
Two sentences with *had* + participle.
Record 90 seconds of the whole story. Stay *calm* and finish with *In the end*.

apariciones.subtitulo: Advice about sharing care at home

mision.consigna: A couple you know argue about who does the care work. Give them advice.
requisitos: three pieces of advice, different forms from last time
one piece of advice with a reason
use *care work*, *gender roles* and *to share responsibility*

microtareas.texto: Three pieces of advice about *care work*.
Rewrite *You should* as *It might be a good idea to*.
Record 90 seconds of advice for someone who feels they're *growing apart*.
